text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: CRITICAL: CDN/edge POP eu-west-1 reporting high packet loss (>15%) and increased tail latency. Multiple customer traces showing 5xx/timeout to embeddings and streaming endpoints. Auto-page to #incidents and netops-oncall.

netops-oncall: Acked. I'm on it — taking incident.

samir: Oncall here, I'll be primary for mitigation. quick ask: which services are spiking?

eng-runtime: We see elevated 502/504 for /v1/embeddings and streaming sessions originating from eu-west. Error rate up ~8x last 10m.

jess: Customers reporting degraded completion streams and broken websocket upgrades. Maya from CS looped in.

maya-cs: Major EU customers A and B opening tickets. They see token streaming stalls and reconnects. Need ETA.

priya: I can run edge reachability checks. starting with traceroute and `dig` to POP dns name.

ion: Also check BGP sessions from our VPC egress to CDN POP; saw intermittent flaps earlier.

samir: Good. Priya, paste outputs here. Ion, any provider logs?

priya: `dig pop-eu-west.cdn.example.net @8.8.8.8 +short` -> returns 52.16.34.89 and 52.16.34.90 (expected).

priya: `traceroute -n 52.16.34.89` -> hops show last two hops timeout, consistent packet loss starting at hop 10 (AS12345).

priya: attaching short snippet:
```
  9  10.8.120.1  35.2 ms  34.9 ms  35.1 ms
 10  198.51.100.2  120 ms  125 ms  130 ms
 11  *  *  *    # consistent loss after this
```

ion: Confirming: our BGP monitor shows adjacency resets to AS12345's edge routers around 1749001100..1749001200 window. Looks like provider-side routing regression.

netops-oncall: Opening ticket with CDN vendor now. Ticket 854321 created, escalation to L2 network ops. ETA TBD. Sharing contact.

samir: While vendor works, we should fail traffic to nearest healthy POP (eu-central) for affected prefixes. Can eng-runtime apply traffic steering? Need quick rollback plan.

eng-runtime: We have a weighted steering config in our traffic router. I can push a temporary override to prefer eu-central for production traffic from EU for 20m. Will do a canary for 10% then ramp.

jess: Appreciate it. Can you also add path-based fallback for streaming endpoints only? Lower risk to non-streaming.

eng-runtime: Yep. Patch CLI: `ri traffic override --from eu-west-1 --to eu-central-1 --routes streaming --pct 10 --duration 20m` running now.

eng-runtime: Canary 10% active. Telemetry shows request success for canary users. No regressions so far.

priya: From our side, starting a DNS TTL reduce for pop-eu-west to 30s to speed client re-resolve. `nsupdate` pushed.

ion: Provider replied to ticket — they're seeing a misconfiguration in their edge route-reflector cluster causing intermittent route withdrawal. They're rolling a fix to the rr pair in eu-west. Estimated impact window 30-45m.

samir: Good. Keep vendor messages logged. Jess, prioritize customer comms: short note with mitigation steps and ETA.

maya-cs: Drafting now — saying we detected POP connectivity issues in eu-west, we've rerouted traffic to eu-central, vendor is fixing on their side, we expect restoration within ~45m. Sending to legal for review.

priya: Running continuous pings `ping -c 30 52.16.34.89` — packet loss trending down slightly after vendor's initial push: 18% -> 12% over last 5m.

ion: BGP resets frequency reduced after vendor pushed a hotfix to rr-2 at 1749003000. Still occasional flaps but stability improving.

netops-oncall: Recommend expanding traffic steering from 10% -> 60% over next 5m to shield customers while vendor completes fix. Samir approve?

samir: Approve. Eng-runtime roll.

eng-runtime: Rolling to 60% now. Monitoring key SLIs (p95 latency, 5xx).

eng-runtime: After ramp, p95 decreased 300ms for EU traffic; 5xx rate improving.

jess: Noting: streaming reconnects down by ~70% in 10m window for affected customers.

maya-cs: Shipping interim note to customers now. Will include the workaround to reduce client-side reconnect aggressiveness.

ion: Vendor confirms full route propagation to rr-pair at 1749003600 and committed fix. They will monitor.

priya: Current traceroute shows restored hops and stable latency. `traceroute -n 52.16.34.89` now completes with <40ms to edge.

netops-oncall: We're going to begin rolling back traffic steering to normal over the next 10m and then restore original DNS TTL. Any objections?

samir: No objections. Let's do staged rollback: 60% -> 30% -> 0% over 10m. Keep monitoring for a full 15m post-rollback.

eng-runtime: Rolling back now in 3 steps.

eng-runtime: Rollback complete. Telemetry looks green. No new BGP resets observed in last 12m.

priya: Final checks: pings show <1% loss, traceroutes clean.

ion: Provider says they will open a follow-up RCA and share configs. They believe a bad control-plane update caused RR inconsistency.

samir: Great work team. I'll mark incident as mitigated but remain open for postmortem. Please collect logs and add to the incident runbook.

maya-cs: Customers updated that service is restored. Closing active tickets as resolved, will follow up if customers report anything.

netops-oncall: Creating post-incident doc and scheduling RCA meeting tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Action items: add automated BGP flap alert threshold to 3 resets in 10m, verify TTL reduction playbook, and test failover plan for streaming routes.

jess: Adding checklist items to the incident card. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident mitigated (priority=critical -> mitigated). Incident channel will remain open for RCA notes.
